messages:
Maria (Support): Sophie, saw your note — can you share the invoice ID and a quick screenshot of dashboard vs invoice?
Sophie (Customer): Invoice INV-2026-0321, charged $4,120. Dashboard shows ~2,050 tokens for that window (see screenshot). We only sent ~2k tokens that day. Billing spike appears 00:00-00:12 UTC.
Maria (Support): Thanks — assigning Raj from billing. @Raj (Billing) can you take a look?
Raj (Billing): On it. Pulling metering events now — can you confirm customer org id and API key prefix?
Sophie (Customer): Org: nimbus-retail, key prefix: rk_live_nimxxx
Raj (Billing): Found matching ledger entries. There's an unusual duplicate of post-batched events for ingestion_id=pb-98a7 between 00:00:10 and 00:00:34. Looks like two identical metering events replayed.
Tim (SRE): FYI we had a rate-limiter failover at 00:00:09 that triggered a batch replay. The replay dedupe check didn't run for events already in-flight due to a race. Repro idea: run a forced failover and verify dedupe.
Tim (SRE): Log snippet:
```
2026-03-14T00:00:09Z rate-limiter: failover start batch_id=pb-98a7
2026-03-14T00:00:10Z metering: emit event id=evt-7f3a tokens=1024 org=nimbus-retail
2026-03-14T00:00:11Z metering: emit event id=evt-7f3a tokens=1024 org=nimbus-retail (replayed)
```
Raj (Billing): That shows double-count. The ledger has 2x tokens for that time window. Looks like customer billed for 4,096 tokens instead of ~2,048.
Maria (Support): Sophie — do you want provisional credit while we fix this? We usually issue provisional credit and then finalize after revrec note.
Sophie (Customer): Yes please, provisional credit would be great. We need a final corrected invoice for our accounting team.
Raj (Billing): I'll put up a provisional credit for $2,060 now (50% of charged amount) pending audit. GL code: 420-COGS; revrec note: 'Metering duplication due to post-batch replay; credit issued pending root cause fix and corrected invoice.'
FinanceBot: Ticket FIN-2026-4589 created for provisional credit. Assigned to Raj.
Tim (SRE): Root cause: dedupe race between in-flight event watermark and replay guard. Patch PR: infra/metering: add optimistic replay token guard. Deploy ETA 4 hours.
Maria (Support): Noted. I'll update the customer and schedule a follow-up once patch is live and audit completes.
Sophie (Customer): Thanks all — please include the final corrected invoice and the revrec note for our records.
Raj (Billing): Will do. Final invoice reissue ETA 24-48 hours after audit. I'll post ledger adjustment tx id when done.
Maria (Support): Closing loop — provisional credit issued, engineering patch in flight. Reopen if anything else.
Tim (SRE): Adding monitoring alert to detect >1 event id in 5s for same org+batch. :white_check_mark:
Maria (Support): :thumbsup:
